NAME FORMS: Facebook 'Little Lobster | Nonthaburi' (EN) / 'Little Lobster, นนทบุรี' (TH); logo wordmark 'Little Lobster Cafe & Bistro'; TikTok display name 'Little Lobster Cafe and Bistro'; the venue always writes its name as 'Little Lobster🦞' with the lobster emoji in captions.

TAGLINES (venue's own): 'Your Neighborhood French-Italian Gem' (facebook-02 graphic); 'Great Food with Good 🍷' (reel 402984929354181); 'It's Lunchtime' (lunch card); 'ร้านอาหารอิตาเลียนฝรั่งเศส สไตล์โฮมมี่ ประชาชื่น 9' (IG bio).

PALETTE seen in owner graphics: cream/off-white paper texture backgrounds with torn-paper edges (facebook-01, -03); warm taupe-brown text panel (facebook-01); deep red / burgundy accents for prices and headlines ('490+', 'It's Lunchtime', dark-red band in facebook-05); gold serif overlay type on the interior graphic (facebook-02); Christmas graphic adds red ribbon and pine (facebook-03).

INTERIOR (facebook-02, https://www.facebook.com/LittleLlobster/posts/956538449835928): burgundy tufted leather chesterfield sofa, teal velvet dining chairs, marble-top tables, dark marble bar front with black glossy tile backsplash and bottle shelves, warm amber pendant lamps, textured plaster wall with small framed prints — dim, clubby, bistro mood.

FOOD STYLING (facebook-04/-05/-06): white round plates on dark marble; European bistro plating — pork chop and steaks on mash with glossy sauces, duck leg with orange sauce, grilled lobster halves, truffle pizza, spaghetti, salmon on spinach, beef cheek in wine sauce.

TONE OF VOICE (all captions, https://www.facebook.com/LittleLlobster/videos/402984929354181/): Thai, warm and neighbourly ('สไตล์โฮมมี่', 'บรรยากาศชิล ๆ', 'อบอุ่นและเป็นกันเอง', 'ฟีลกู้ด'), addresses locals as 'ชาวนนทบุเรี่ยน', mixes English menu names and taglines, heavy emoji use (🦞🍷🍝✨👍😋🌟), invisible-separator line breaks, and a fixed closing block: hours 🕗 / location 🚙 / Line 📲 / Call 📞 / Inbox 📨 plus hashtags #LittleLobster #ItalianFrenchCuisine #FusionFood #Family #Dinner #ร้านอาหารฟิวชั่น #ร้านอาหารครอบครัว #ประชาชื่น.

RECURRING MOTIFS: polaroid photo frames for dish menus (facebook-03), torn-paper card edges (facebook-01), third-party endorsement badges ('ครัวคุณหรีด แนะนำ' gold ribbon, 'Check-in Chill' reel), 'Menu 1–4' numbered picks, '+' price suffix (490+, 999+, 1,299+).

Counts: found 35 photos (28 user photos -> _reference/wongnai, 7 restaurant-menu photos -> _real/wongnai; all kept, all >=900px long side, delivered size recorded); found 7 priced menu items + 2 prices from reviews/tags + 5 unpriced dish tags; found 6 reviews (3 with text, 3 rating-only) — fewer than the 8-12 requested because only 6 exist; found 24 facts. Owner vs user: Wongnai marks NO photos as official/owner on this listing — every photo carries a user uploader (Do D, Halulugun, Sasina, Piyarat V.), so all 28 are filed as reference. One uploader's captions read in an owner-like voice, which would make that account owner-affiliated — but that is inference and was never confirmed, so those photos, including the clean logo file, stay reference tier. The 7 menu photos are filed as real on the basis that they are the merchant-managed Wongnai/LINE MAN menu items (description 'multiChannel', priced, deliveryAllowed) — moderate confidence; downgrade if certainty is required. Image inspection: all 35 kept files were viewed from pixels via three 3-column contact sheets (640px cells, filenames labelled) plus the four 'menu/sign' images at full resolution; descriptions above are from those pixels. No image showed a legible printed menu card (the fence poster is unreadable at 960px; Wongnai CDN caps at 960), so no menu transcription from images was possible. Discrepancies to flag: (1) hours — Wongnai 11:00-20:30 daily vs the venue's own A-board 11.00-21.00 (Oct 2022 photos); (2) two different-looking exteriors — a white villa wall/iron gate at no. 34 with a round lit sign (Sasina 2022) vs a glass-fronted two-storey building with wooden LITTLE LOBSTER sign and striped awnings (Halulugun 2021, Do D 2023); plausibly the glass building sits inside the gated compound (Do D: parking in the house grounds), but unverified; (3) the menu photo attached to 'สปาเกตตี้คาโบนารา' shows a mushroom oil-based spaghetti; (4) Wongnai lists only 'Steak House' — no pet-friendly, private-room or live-music attributes exist on Wongnai (petFriendly null), so those early signals are neither confirmed nor denied here; (5) Wongnai's Instagram field is 'littlelobster2020' — @lobster.little does not appear on Wongnai. brand_cues: LOGO (press-06 sign photo, press-01 menu centre, press-02 sticker; https://www.lemon8-app.com/@toonwcrp/7337642942930092545): round white disc; hand-painted red lobster with loose black brush antennae; hand-lettered black caps 'LITTLE LOBSTER' where the second O of LOBSTER is drawn as a lobster claw; 'CAFE & BISTRO' in small letterspaced caps beneath; small Thai name 'ลิตเติ้ลลอบสเตอร์ คาเฟ่ แอนด์ บริสโตร' arcing along the top edge of the disc.

SIGN CONTEXT (press-06): disc mounted on a deep green textured/plaster wall with tree shadows — dark green + white + red is the strongest colour signal; the same dark green marble/terrazzo appears as table tops under plates in press-02/07/08/14.

EXTERIOR (press-11, https://www.lemon8-app.com/@bubuub_bu/7370719159489397249): low-rise house-like frontage — dark wood slat fence with white painted 'LITTLE LOBSTER', cream/white striped fabric awning over a full-glass facade with sheer curtains, white urn planters, grey tiled forecourt. Reads as a converted residence but no source states this explicitly.

PRIVATE ROOM (press-05): one long live-edge polished wood table, dark grey/teal high-back upholstered chairs (~8–10), floor-length brown curtains, dark wood floor, warm downlights — reviewers' words: 'บรรยากาศร้านอบอุ่น เป็นกันเอง มีห้องจัดเลี้ยงด้วย'.

TABLEWARE (press-07/09/10/14, press-13): white stoneware with rustic brown speckled rims; white scalloped plate for the lobster; wooden pizza boards; grey stoneware for braises; pink Himalayan salt block for duck; blue-and-orange folk-pattern dessert plate; red enamel cocottes used as props in the printed menu.

PRINTED MENU (press-01, press-04): black header band with red script 'Menu'; photo-grid tiles with English name + small Thai name; lunch-set card in tan/brown with white type and the logo — bilingual, photo-led, classic bistro dishes (foie gras, escargot, lamb shank, beef wellington, tournedos).

TONE reviewers give it (verbatim Thai): 'ร้านลับ', 'สไตล์โฮมมี่', 'บรรยากาศอบอุ่นเหมือนทานอาหารที่บ้าน', 'เป็นกันเอง', 'ของดีเมืองนนท์', 'เหมาะกับการพาแฟนมาเดท', 'ราคาน่ารัก / ราคาเป็นมิตร', 'ฝีมือระดับเชฟ', 'วัตถุดิบหายาก' — hidden neighbourhood bistro, chef-cooked, unpretentious.

RECURRING HERO DISH in every image set: the whole red lobster over spaghetti (garlic + dried chilli) — the name-sake plate; second-tier heroes: truffle pizza on wood board, sliced wagyu picanha with mash, chocolate lava cake.

brand_cues: Logo: single-colour red line-art lobster mark with a 'LITTLE LOBSTER' wordmark, printed as a repeating pattern on the food-basket paper liners — seen in https://img.wongnai.com/p/1920x0/2023/10/31/327cf86faff54ea79c5476cb9160b0d1.jpg (MIXED FRIED) and https://img.wongnai.com/p/1920x0/2025/04/03/b59b3020679648e588495f1f91b1f2d9.jpg (fried squid). Red on white is the only brand colour evidenced on my hosts.

Menu voice on the LINE MAN storefront (https://www.wongnai.com/delivery/businesses/721221yS/order): bilingual, ALL-CAPS English headings ('GRILLED LOBSTER', 'BBQ PORK RIB', 'CHICKEN WING') with Thai subtitles; casual first-person Thai descriptions written by the shop ('ก็ลองสั่งสักหน่อย อร่อยมาก', 'อร่อยฉ่ำๆ', 'น่าอร่อย'); several typos left as printed ('knucklee', 'seafoodd', 'Frenfies') — homey rather than polished.

Storefront category labels mix Thai and English: อาหารฟิวชั่น / สเต็ก / SALAD (สลัด) / Main (อาหารหลัก) / PASTA / Starter(เมนูกินเล่น) / ขนม (https://www.wongnai.com/delivery/businesses/721221yS/order).

Plating and props recurring across the owner photos: black or dark-green marble tabletops (delivery-03, -21, -32, -33), white scalloped-edge plates for pasta (delivery-05, -20 to -25), grey stoneware plates for braises (delivery-12, -13, -27), newspaper-print paper (delivery-14, -35), cut-glass stands and glass cake domes for desserts (delivery-35 to -37), edible flowers (pansy/dianthus/daisy) on tongue, squid and dessert (delivery-30, -31, -34).

French/European motif in the room: an Eiffel Tower print poster is visible behind the fish burger (https://img.wongnai.com/p/1920x0/2023/04/25/64c6a65efbcd487cae1a966e18fe8b2a.jpg); a wine glass and a menu book appear beside the duck leg (https://img.wongnai.com/p/1920x0/2023/10/31/d7182e5b01e64c1d981e18d3204bd18b.jpg).

Signature-dish emphasis on the storefront: lobster leads the first category (GRILLED LOBSTER ฿1,268; lobster baked with cheese ฿1,590) and the platform badges CHICKEN WING as แนะนำ 1 and carbonara as แนะนำ 2.
